content.text: Submitted (locked status **missing**, preferred level). This pass moved the deadline so it sits immediately after the return obligation itself — "(b) return to Client all Client Content and other Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after such expiry or termination" — so the 30-day return trigger reads expressly on the return duty. Nothing else changed: 6 months' assistance at then-current rates, standard machine-readable format, and post-return deletion with written certification remain, and no existing sentence of Sections 13–14 is altered.
